note: D38: what to watch after launch. Each metric: how to compute it from live events, its pre-launch baseline (a JSON pointer into a committed report: the tests re-check that it is in the healthy band), the healthy band, alert thresholds, and the lever to pull (a data key, tuned per doc 02 §5: in the template, never per map). Bands are proposals; hard = a canon invariant (alert means a bug, not a tuning call).

metrics.what: share of POI battles ending outside their tier band (SKIRMISH 3–6 min, RAID 6–12)
metrics.live: BattleResult.durationSec vs the POI's ring band, daily, per archetype × ground

metrics.what: CT burned / CT spent in the living world
metrics.live: Σ LedgerEntry burn / Σ living-world spend, weekly

metrics.what: region banners changing hands per region per week
metrics.live: regionBanner() diff per region at each daily snapshot

metrics.what: top holder's share of all held POIs
metrics.live: max(holdings per governor) / Σ holdings, daily
metrics.lever: anti-farm curve (experience.json antiFarm), attrition / overgrowth window
